```{r}
#install packages (see ../requirements.txt)
library(tidyverse)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(rvest)
```


```{r}
#setting directories: 
# input data (the analytical sample)
analysis_path <- file.path("..", "data", "analysis_data")
# create directory if it does not exist
if (!dir.exists(analysis_path)) {
  dir.create(analysis_path)
}

out_dir <- file.path("..", "out")
dir.create(
  out_dir,
  recursive = TRUE,
  showWarnings = FALSE
)

# setting figure output directory
figures_dir <- file.path(out_dir, "figures")
dir.create(
  figures_dir,
  recursive = TRUE,
  showWarnings = FALSE
)
```

```{r load_data}
# analytical sample: 
df <- read_csv(file.path(analysis_path, "analysis_df.csv"))

# checking dataframe structure and dimensions
str(df) #should be comma-separated (3997 rows, 36 columns)

```
```{r}
#for analysis, transcription notes are omitted, and treated as NA:
df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    across(
      where(is.character),
      ~ na_if(.x, "could_not_transcribe")
    )
  )

# changing data types:
df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    # Standardizing dates
    admission_date = as.Date(admission_date),
    discharge_date = as.Date(discharge_date),
    date_of_birth = as.Date(date_of_birth),

    # Extracting years
    birth_year = lubridate::year(date_of_birth),
    admission_year = lubridate::year(admission_date),
    discharge_year = lubridate::year(discharge_date),

    # Factorizing defined categorical variables
    sex_series = factor(sex_series),
    sex = factor(sex),
    marital_status = factor(marital_status),

    # Numeric / sequential variables
    series_page = as.integer(series_page),
    crowd_id = as.integer(crowd_id),
    
    #cat:
    patient_key = as.character(patient_key)
  )

```

```{r}
# Recoding obvious textual variants
diagnosis_recode <- c(
  "melank" = "melankoli",
  "mel"    = "melankoli",
  "melancholi" = "melankoli",
  "melanch" = "melankoli",
  "mekankoli" = "melankoli",
  "melankol" = "melankoli",
  "forv" = "forvirring",
  "dements" = "demens",
  "dementia" = "demens",
  "mani period" = "mani periodisk",
  "firrykthed" = "forrykthed",
  "forrkt" = "forrykthed",
  "forrykhed" = "forrykthed",
  "forrykt" = "forrykthed",
  "dem prac" = "dementia præcox",
  "dem præcox"= "dementia præcox",
  "dem præc" = "dementia præcox",
  "dem pre" = "dementia præcox"
  )

# Standardizing diagnosis strings for analysis
df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    diagnosis_standardized = diagnosis_at_admission %>%
      str_to_lower() %>%
      str_remove_all("[[:punct:]]") %>%
      str_squish()%>%
      na_if(""),

    diagnosis_standardized = case_when(
      str_detect(diagnosis_standardized, "obs") ~ "obs",
      TRUE ~ diagnosis_standardized
    ),

    diagnosis_standardized = recode(
      diagnosis_standardized,
      !!!diagnosis_recode,
      .default = diagnosis_standardized
    )
  )
df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    diagnosis_standardized = recode(
      diagnosis_standardized,
      !!!diagnosis_recode,
      .default = diagnosis_standardized
    )
  )

# viewing the standardized diagnoses
clean_diagnosis_counts <- df %>%
  count(diagnosis_standardized, sort = TRUE)
clean_diagnosis_counts

cat("Number of clean diagnosis:", nrow(clean_diagnosis_counts)) #495

```

```{r diagnoses_by_sex}
# Comparing diagnoses across the two archival series
diagnosis_by_series <- df %>%
  count(
    sex_series,
    diagnosis_standardized
  ) %>%
  group_by(sex_series) %>%
  mutate(
    proportion = n / sum(n)
  ) %>%
  arrange(sex_series, desc(n)) %>%
  ungroup()

diagnosis_by_series
```

```{r top_ten_diagnoses}
# Top 10 most frequent standardized diagnoses overall
top_10_diagnoses <- df %>%
  filter(!is.na(diagnosis_standardized)) %>%
  count(diagnosis_standardized, sort = TRUE) %>%
  slice_head(n = 10) %>%
  pull(diagnosis_standardized)

# Overall: top 10 diagnoses over time
diagnosis_over_time <- df %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(diagnosis_standardized),
    !is.na(admission_year)
  ) %>%
  group_by(admission_year) %>%
  mutate(total_diagnoses = n()) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(diagnosis_standardized %in% top_10_diagnoses) %>%
  count(
    admission_year,
    diagnosis_standardized,
    total_diagnoses
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    proportion = n / total_diagnoses,
    diagnosis_standardized = factor(
      diagnosis_standardized,
      levels = top_10_diagnoses
    )
  )

# By sex: same top 10 diagnoses over time
diagnosis_over_time_sex <- df %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(diagnosis_standardized),
    !is.na(admission_year)
  ) %>%
  group_by(sex_series, admission_year) %>%
  mutate(total_diagnoses = n()) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(diagnosis_standardized %in% top_10_diagnoses) %>%
  count(
    sex_series,
    admission_year,
    diagnosis_standardized,
    total_diagnoses
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    proportion = n / total_diagnoses,
    diagnosis_standardized = factor(
      diagnosis_standardized,
      levels = top_10_diagnoses
    )
  )

# Frequency distribution among non-missing diagnoses
diagnosis_counts <- df %>%
  filter(!is.na(diagnosis_standardized)) %>%
  count(diagnosis_standardized, sort = TRUE)

# Number of non-missing diagnoses
n_nonmissing_diagnoses <- sum(diagnosis_counts$n)

# Number accounted for by the 10 most frequent diagnoses
n_top10 <- diagnosis_counts %>%
  slice_head(n = 10) %>%
  summarise(n = sum(n)) %>%
  pull(n)

# Percentage
top10_percentage <- n_top10 / n_nonmissing_diagnoses * 100

cat(
  "Non-missing diagnoses:", n_nonmissing_diagnoses, "\n",
  "Top 10 observations:", n_top10, "\n",
  "Top 10 percentage:", round(top10_percentage, 1), "%\n"
)
sum(df$sex_series == "men", na.rm = TRUE)
```

```{r diagnoses_all}
# Plotting overall distribution of diagnoses over time
diagnosis_over_time_plot <- ggplot(
  diagnosis_over_time,
  aes(
    x = admission_year,
    y = proportion,
    color = diagnosis_standardized
  )
) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(size = 1.5) +

    breaks = seq(1889, 1914, by = 2)

    title = "Most Frequent Diagnoses Over Time",
    subtitle = "Ten most frequently recorded diagnoses overall",
    x = "Admission year",
    y = "Proportion within year",
    color = "Diagnosis"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

diagnosis_over_time_plot

# Saving plot
ggsave(
  filename = file.path(
    figures_dir,
    "top_10_diagnoses_all.png"
  ),
  plot = diagnosis_over_time_plot,
  width = 8,
  height = 5,
  dpi = 300
)

```

```{r condition_variable_standardization}
# from inspection of unique condition string: 
condition_recode <- c(
  "helbredet"    = "helbredt",
  "helbr"        = "helbredt",
  "uhelbredet"   = "uhelbredt",
  "uforandr"     = "uhelbredt",
  "uforand"      = "uhelbredt",
  "uforandret"   = "uhelbredt",
  "sindsyg"      = "uhelbredt",
  "genindlagt"   = "genindlagt",
  "uhelbr"       = "uhelbredt",
  "uhelbredelig" = "uhelbredt",
  "uh"           = "uhelbredt",
  "uhel"         = "uhelbredt",
  "uhelbre"      = "uhelbredt",
  "bedr"         = "bedret",
  "bedring"      = "bedret",
  "bedrt"        = "bedret",
  "bedring"      = "bedret",
  "bredret"      = "bedret",
  "paa prøve"    = "på prøve",
  "afdød"        = "død"
)

df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    condition_standardized = case_when(
      str_detect(condition_at_discharge, "\\buhelbredet\\b") ~ "uhelbredt",
      str_detect(condition_at_discharge, "\\bhelbredet\\b") ~ "helbredt",
      str_detect(condition_at_discharge, "\\bbedret\\b") ~ "bedret",
      str_detect(condition_at_discharge, "\\bdød\\b") ~ "død",
      str_detect(condition_at_discharge, "\\bpaa prøve\\b") ~ "på prøve",
      TRUE ~ condition_at_discharge
    ),

    condition_standardized = recode(
      condition_standardized,
      !!!condition_recode,
      .default = condition_standardized
      #(everything else should be treated as NA)
    )
  )

clean_condition_counts <- df %>%
  count(condition_standardized, sort = TRUE)

cat(
  "Number of cleaned conditions:",
  nrow(clean_condition_counts))

clean_condition_counts

```

```{r setting categories}
# Retaining only defined discharge-condition categories
valid_conditions <- c(
  "helbredt",
  "bedret",
  "uhelbredt",
  "død",
  "på prøve",
  "genindlagt"
)

df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    condition_standardized = if_else(
      condition_standardized %in% valid_conditions,
      condition_standardized,
      NA_character_
    )
  )

#checking
clean_condition_counts <- df %>%
  count(condition_standardized, sort = TRUE)
clean_condition_counts
```
```{r condition_vs_na}
# Comparing retained conditions with NA
condition_validity <- df %>%
  mutate(
    condition_status = if_else(
      is.na(condition_standardized),
      "NA",
      "Retained"
    )
  ) %>%
  count(condition_status) %>%
  mutate(
    proportion = n / sum(n),
    percent = proportion * 100
  )

condition_validity
```

```{r conditions_over_time}
condition_over_time <- df %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(condition_standardized),
    !is.na(admission_year)
  ) %>%
  group_by(admission_year) %>%
  mutate(total_conditions = n()) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  count(
    admission_year,
    condition_standardized,
    total_conditions
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    proportion = n / total_conditions
  )

# Number of non-missing discharge conditions
n_distinct_conditions <- df %>%
  summarise(
    n = n_distinct(condition_standardized, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  pull(n)

# Number of non-missing discharge conditions
n_nonmissing_conditions <- df %>%
  summarise(
    n = sum(!is.na(condition_standardized))
  ) %>%
  pull(n)

cat(
  "Distinct conditions:", n_distinct_conditions, "\n",
  "Non-missing conditions:", n_nonmissing_conditions, "\n"
)
```

```{r conditions_sex}
# Comparing discharge conditions across sex series

  ) %>%

condition_by_series

# plotting sex-differences

  condition_by_series,
  aes(
    x = sex_series,
    y = proportion,
    fill = condition_standardized
  )
) +
  geom_col() +

  # Percentage labels
  geom_text(
    aes(
      label = scales::percent(proportion, accuracy = 0.1)
    ),
    position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5),
    size = 2.2
  ) +

  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  scale_fill_discrete(
    labels = \(x) str_to_sentence(x)
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Recorded Discharge Conditions by Sex",
    subtitle = "Distribution of retained discharge conditions, 1889–1913",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Proportion of recorded conditions",
    fill = "Condition at discharge"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

### INFERENTIAL ANALYSES 
```{r chi_square_condition_sex}

# Contingency table: sex × condition at discharge
condition_sex_table <- df %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(sex_series),
    !is.na(condition_standardized)
  ) %>%
  count(
    sex_series,
    condition_standardized
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = condition_standardized,
    values_from = n,
    values_fill = 0
  )

condition_sex_table
```
```{r}
condition_sex_matrix <- df %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(sex_series),
    !is.na(condition_standardized)
  ) %>%
  with(
    table(sex_series, condition_standardized)
  )

condition_sex_matrix
```
```{r}
condition_sex_chisq <- chisq.test(condition_sex_matrix)
condition_sex_chisq

condition_sex_chisq$expected
```
```{r}
sum(condition_sex_chisq$expected < 5)

mean(condition_sex_chisq$expected < 5)
```
```{r}
condition_sex_chisq$stdres
```

```{r}
n <- sum(condition_sex_matrix)

cramers_v <- sqrt(
  as.numeric(condition_sex_chisq$statistic) /
    (n * min(
      nrow(condition_sex_matrix) - 1,
      ncol(condition_sex_matrix) - 1
    ))
)

cramers_v
```
